posts.title: Meteorologist to West Coasters – Prepare Now
posts.description: Triple threat coming to the West Coast – El Niño, King Tide, Atmospheric River. Plus Climate change, which he does not mention. Oh, also, Christmas might be even worse, so Happy Holidays.

posts.title: Recapping Florida’s Deluge – More to Come
posts.description: This would ordinarily be the “Dry Season” in Florida. These rains are consistent with a massive El Niño, which is just starting to peak now, and has months yet to run. Florida just voted to cut property taxes, (ie services, including police, fire, and flood control) despite warnings from, among others, the State Sheriff’s Association. … Continue reading "Recapping Florida’s Deluge – More to Come"
